stem:
Parul lists ways people depend on forests and protected areas.

Which claims correctly identify benefits humans receive from ecosystems? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Forests can provide fresh air and help keep soil fertile.
Protected areas help conserve wildlife and habitats that support life.
Ecosystem benefits are only the money earned from selling timber.
Forests benefit people only when no plants grow there.

teacher.key_rationale: People receive services and resources such as fresh air, fertile soil, and conserved wildlife habitats. Reducing benefits to timber money alone, or requiring forests with no plants, misses that hinge.
